info.name: AppLovin Axon Campaign Management Ad Units Growth Reporting API

params.name: api_key
params.description: Report Key, found under Account > Keys in the Axon dashboard.

params.name: start
params.description: Inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD or Unix epoch seconds. Must be within a 45-day window with end.

params.name: end
params.description: Inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD, Unix epoch seconds, or the literal string `now`.

params.name: columns
params.description: Comma-separated list of columns to include. Available columns differ between publisher and advertiser report types.

params.name: report_type
params.description: Choose between publisher or advertiser report dimensions.

params.name: day_column
params.description: Set to `day` to compute cohort metrics. Defaults to realtime when absent.

params.name: not_zero
params.description: Set to 1 to exclude rows where all metrics are zero.

items.docs:
Retrieve aggregated AppDiscovery / Axon campaign metrics for either
the publisher or advertiser perspective. Date ranges are limited to a
45-day rolling window. The response payload shape varies with the
selected `columns` and `report_type`.
